No ℓ² edge state at kappa=0; circularity and convexity give open/closed disks. With r=1−s, exact kappa=(c0²/c)s+c s²/(1−s) yields quadratic coefficient a³/(4b(a+b)u⁴). Independent scalar small-kappa root tests agree, but mathematical correctness does not confer originality.
